title: Bigg Boss 20: Amrapali Dubey snaps at Mahhi Vij, says ‘I am not your servant’
text:
Bigg Boss 20: Amrapali Dubey loses her cool at Mahhi Vij 
 Home / Entertainment / Television News / Article / Bigg Boss 20: Amrapali Dubey snaps at Mahhi Vij, says ‘I am not your servant’ 
 Bigg Boss 20: Amrapali Dubey snaps at Mahhi Vij, says ‘I am not your servant’
 Updated On: 27 October, 2026 07:19 PM IST | Mumbai | mid-day online correspondent 
 Amrapali Dubey and Mahhi Vij get into a heated argument on Bigg Boss 20 over cooking duties. After Mahhi asks her to prepare dal quickly, Amrapali loses her cool and says, "I am not your servant"
 Listen to this article : Mahhi Vij, Amrapali (Pics/X, Special Arrangements)
 Tensions in the Bigg Boss 20 house are rising after the recent Weekend Ka Vaar episode. While the housemates continue to struggle for ration and fight over duties, an argument breaks out between Mahhi Vij and Amrapali over the same. Recently, Amrapali was preparing food, and it was delayed. As Mahhi kept pestering her, Amrapali reacted strongly and called her out.
 Amrapali and Mahhi clash over duties
 In the upcoming episode, Amrapali Dubey and Mahhi Vij will be seen engaging in a heated exchange after a discussion about preparing food turns into an argument. In the recently released promo, Mahhi is seen asking Amrapali to prepare the dal quickly. However, Amrapali points out that the dish will take the time it needs to cook. Mahhi, on the other hand, expresses concern about the consequences of the food not being ready on time. She tells Amrapali that the other housemates will question her if the meal is delayed. Amrapali appears increasingly irritated by the repeated instructions. She subsequently loses her cool and lashes out at Mahhi, making her displeasure clear. Reacting strongly to the exchange, she says, “I am not your servant. Don't pester me.”
